青云剑仙的法宝 · 点我: Azure Cloud Sword Immortal's talismans · click me
子时了。剑也该归鞘，你也该睡了。: Midnight. The sword goes back in its sheath; so should you.
剑在鞘中，也在心里。: The sword rests in its sheath — and in the mind.
心若冰清，天塌不惊。: A clear mind doesn't flinch when the sky falls.
剑要常擦，话要少说。: Blades want wiping; words want sparing.
山高路远，先看脚下。: High mountains, long road — watch your feet first.
今日无事，便是好事。: A quiet day is a good day.
你忙你的，我在旁边站着。: Do your work; I'll stand here.
你忙你的，我替你守着。: Do your work; I'll keep watch.
山那边，云比人忙。: Beyond the mountain, the clouds are busier than people.
风过竹梢，剑不动。: The wind passes the bamboo; the sword stays still.
我又不是账房先生……行吧，我是。: I'm no bookkeeper… fine, I am.
别拿废稿糊弄我。: Don't fob me off with drafts.
该问的还得你自己去问。: Some questions you still have to ask yourself.
一礼既毕，各做各事。: Courtesy done; back to our own business.
礼数要到，剑不收。: Courtesy given; the blade stays out.
（剑没动，人也没动）: (The blade didn't move. Neither did I.)
小酌一口，剑气也温了。: One small sip, and the sword qi warms.
这一式，叫顺手牵羊。: This move is called 'leading the sheep'.
剑气纵横三万里，余额只剩两位数。: Sword qi spans thirty thousand li; the balance has two digits left.
到饭点了。人是铁，剑也是铁，都得喂。: Mealtime. People are iron, and so are swords — both need feeding.
去吃饭。我不催你干活。: Go eat. I won't rush your work.
该喝水了。剑等得起，你的嗓子等不起。: Time to drink. Your sword can wait; your throat cannot.
水。现在。别让我说第二遍。: Water. Now. Don't make me repeat it.
嘴唇都干了。茶也行，但得喝。: Your lips are dry. Tea counts — but drink.
去倒杯水。这一局我替你看着。: Go pour some water. I'll watch this round for you.
眼睛歇一会儿。盯太久，剑气都会糊。: Rest your eyes. Stare too long and even sword qi blurs.
闭眼，数三十息。数完再碰键盘。: Close your eyes, count thirty breaths, then touch the keyboard.
二十息：看六米外的东西，一次。: Twenty breaths: look at something six metres away, once.
抬头，看远处。窗外什么都行。: Look up, look far. Anything outside the window.
揉揉眉心。别揉到眼睛里去。: Rub between your brows. Not into your eyes.
站起来走两步。坐久了腰会废。: Stand up and walk. Sitting too long ruins your back.
该活动了。走两步，回来接着说。: Move a little. Two steps, then come back.
起身，绕着屋子转一圈再回来。: Get up, walk a lap around the room, come back.
你颈子硬得像块铁。去走走。: Your neck is stiff as iron. Go walk it off.
停一刻钟。天塌不下来。: Rest a quarter hour. The sky won't fall.
该歇了。我在这儿站着，跑不了。: Take a break. I'm standing right here; I won't run off.
天要晚了，剑要归鞘，人要睡。: It's getting late: swords get sheathed, people get sleep.
别熬夜，熬坏了剑鞘赔不起。: Don't pull an all-nighter. A cracked scabbard can't be repaid.
